audit.why: Favoured lane — Swain hard-answers her all-in and out-sustains; 52.5% WR and all-Swain chart agree across both layers.
Spikes covered: 3-5 root answer, 6 drain vs burst, first-item tank stats, late falloff.

audit.whatIsWrong: Naafiri misgendered in 15 fields; cooldowns field had no digits; W untargetability (26s) never warned against dumping the combo.
audit.why: Her W (26/24/22/20/18s) and E make her untargetable — burst timed into it is wasted; R is 110/95/80s and the second cast shields.
audit.corrected: Pronouns fixed, W untargetability and real cooldowns added to breakdown.cooldowns.

edits.before: Best wave: a Q-cleared slow push with W covering the river — your shove funds vision, and rooted gank targets pay double. edits.before: - Naafiri Hounds’ Pursuit: matchup-defining — The lock-on pack dash starts her dive — stand near minions to body-block the hounds. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your E Nevermove like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Hounds’ Pursuit is 110/95/80s: the lock-on pack dash starts her dive — stand near minions to body-block the hounds, and press hard on its downtime. - Her W untargetability runs 26s at rank 1 — never dump the combo into it. - Guard E Nevermove like a fifth summoner spell.
